newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 100 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 100 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 100 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.

The Bank allotted all 100 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before May 27. It has now provided liquidity totalling 1.7 billion stg, exactly matching its revised money market shortage forecast.
The Bank said discount houses had made no use of the late repo facility by 1350 GMT.
